profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Divide Studio | Master's in Computer Science
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at LinenMaster and a software consultant at Strategis Consulting, LLC, I apply my full-stack development skills to create efficient and user-friendly applications for various clients and projects. I work with a range of technologies, such as C#, PHP, AWS, APIs, and databases, to deliver high-quality solutions that meet the needs and expectations of the end-users.

I graduated from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro with a bachelor's degree in computer science in May 2022. During my studies, I developed a passion for software and learned a variety of programming languages and paradigms. I also participated in many open-source projects and honed my leadership and communication skills. My goal is to work on innovative ideas that can benefit the general population and to learn and experiment with new software. I believe the possibility with software is limitless.
